## Key Research & Projects
- **AutoTriage AI:** Original Python, HTML5, and JavaScript source code for automated customer support triage system using NLP, vector similarity, and keyword logic. Registered Government of India Copyright (ROC: SW-2026023768, App No: SW-6982/2026-CO). Co-authored and presented peer-reviewed research at the NCRENB-2026 national conference.
- **PolyFarm:** Multi-agent AI platform for agricultural guidance. Top 30 Finalist out of 400 teams at The GenAI Hackathon Mumbai.
- **CricLegend:** Cross-platform digital cricket scoring and tournament management application built with Flutter and Supabase.
- **Hyuzz:** Visual discovery web platform featuring pixel picking and hexadecimal color search. (https://hyuzz.vercel.app/app)
